Comma Insurance

Personal Lines Insurance advisor

Job Overview

Comma revolutionizes property and casualty insurance through a brokerage model prioritizing customers, leveraging multi-carrier flexibility to deliver a delightful insurance experience. The tight-knit team drives innovation in a high-growth environment, seeking innovators eager to own their impact. The Personal Lines Insurance Advisor is pivotal in guiding clients toward optimal Property, Casualty, and Life insurance solutions to protect their families and assets. In line with Comma's mission to "insure their story continues," this role integrates expert advisory services with strategic sales in a performance-oriented, values-aligned compensation framework. The position emphasizes advancing product promotion and expanding business to drive growth.

Requirements
  • Licensing: Active Property & Casualty Insurance License (Recommended)
  • Experience: Previous experience in personal lines insurance is preferable.
  • Sales Acumen: Demonstrated ability to generate leads, cross-sell and upsell effectively. (insurance sector advantageous but not mandatory)
  • Exceptional phone etiquette and verbal communication skills.
  • High School diploma or equivalent.

What we offer:

  • Comprehensive onboarding and training
  • We will invest in you so that you become licensed in more states!
  • Minimum Monthly base pay + 60% Uncapped Monthly Commissions
  • Aggressive Quarterly Sales Incentive with potential to earn up to 100% commission
  • Employer Sponsored Benefits (medical, dental, vision)



  • 401K retirement plan with company match


Responsibilities
  • Client Needs Assessment: Conduct evaluations to understand clients' specific insurance needs and provide personalized solutions.
  • Sales Target Achievement: Strive to meet and exceed sales targets by adopting resourceful sales approach.
  • Cross-Selling Opportunities: Identify and capitalize on cross-selling opportunities to maximize client coverage.
  • Champion a growth-oriented approach by marketing insurance products.
  • Build prospective business opportunities through proactive cold calls, emails, referrals, and networking.
  • Assess client policy portfolios to propose supplementary coverage aligned with evolving needs, while upholding absolute confidentiality in all interactions.
